instruction: When I reply to emails with my signature enabled, the signature appears below the quoted text. I want it to appear above the quoted original message instead. Please configure the signature to be placed above the quote in replies.

metadata.explanation: Task requires placing signature above the quote (sig_bottom=false). When false, signature appears above quoted text in replies. Evaluator checks if mail.identity.id1.sig_bottom is set to false. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the Thunderbird preference 'mail.identity.id1.sig_bottom' which controls signature placement in email replies
Expected value of 'false' is semantically correct: sig_bottom=false means signature appears ABOVE quoted text (not at bottom), matching the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (place signature above quote) and evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window before fetching prefs.js file, ensuring preferences are written to disk
check_thunderbird_prefs metric function correctly parses prefs.js file using regex, extracts key-value pairs, and performs comparison
Logic flow is sound: getter fetches the file, metric parses and validates the specific preference, returns 1.0 for success or 0.0 for failure
State accessibility is ensured: prefs.js is the standard Thunderbird preferences file and will exist after configuration changes

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
